# Effect: phaser

Phaser: sweeping notches that give a flowing, "jet" texture.

**Where to put it**: Good for pad, electric piano, guitar and synth lead; put it before the reverb.

Latest parameters: `muser effects phaser` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rate_hz` | 0.5 | 0 – 100 Hz | Sweep rate. 0.1-0.5 slow; 1-3 obvious |
| `feedback` | 0.3 | -0.95 – 0.95 | Resonance. A larger absolute value is sharper; negative values sound different |
| `mix` | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | Dry/wet mix. 0.5 gives the strongest effect |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "phaser", "rate_hz": 0.3, "feedback": 0.5, "mix": 0.5 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Slow flow (pad, electric piano)

  ```json
  {"type": "phaser", "rate_hz": 0.2, "feedback": 0.3, "mix": 0.5}
  ```

- 70s funk guitar/electric piano

  ```json
  {"type": "phaser", "rate_hz": 0.6, "feedback": 0.5, "mix": 0.5}
  ```

- Intense jet

  ```json
  {"type": "phaser", "rate_hz": 1.5, "feedback": 0.8, "mix": 0.6}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- The effect is most obvious at mix 0.5; higher or lower both weaken the sweep.
- Put phaser before reverb.
